global_non_circularity: consumer cannot create the predicate it consumes
trigger text is not evidence by itself
relationship values are not institutional domains
downstream consequences cannot become upstream prerequisites by narrative implication
one authored source cannot count as multiple independent domains without explicit canonical proof
derived composite evaluators cannot invent missing source state
